welcome.title: Know what shipped. Tell the story.
welcome.description: One workspace for your applications, release history and public release notes.
welcome.authUnavailable: Configure Supabase to sign in. Shiplog does not save release data locally.

empty.title: No workspace yet
empty.description: Create a workspace from the workspace menu, or ask its owner to share one with you in Shiplog.

common.name: Name
common.title: Title
common.readOnly: You have read-only access to this workspace.

applications.description: The products and services your workspace ships.
applications.hint: Public catalogs show only published releases from applications explicitly included here.

releases.previewNotice: Preview only. This shows the public notes and explicitly public changes, without publishing anything.
releases.historyLocked: Release history is locked after first publication, a successful deployment or when it leaves draft status. Unpublishing does not unlock editing.
releases.description: Every version, with internal context and a public story.
releases.publicationNotice: Publishing notes does not deploy this release or change its lifecycle.
releases.noApplications: Create an application before adding its first release.
releases.publishDescription: These public notes will be available through the workspace catalog when the application is included. Internal notes remain private.
releases.confirmUnpublish: Remove these notes from the public catalog? The internal release remains.

deployments.title: Deployments
deployments.description: Environment versions and recorded deployment history.
deployments.notice: Manual records only. Shiplog does not deploy software or verify running systems. Current versions reflect the latest reported successful outcome per environment.
deployments.immutable: Completed outcomes are append-only. Check the environment, version and timestamps before saving. Recording does not publish notes or change approval.
deployments.rollbackNotice: The target must have been deployed to this same environment before. The source must match the reported version at the recorded completion time.
deployments.warningNotice: Production readiness warnings only. Historical outcomes can still be recorded. Warnings are saved with the record.
deployments.timezone: Enter dates in your local timezone: {{timezone}}.
deployments.invalidDates: Enter valid start and completion dates.

readiness.title: Readiness
readiness.templateNotice: Owner-managed template. Saving changes affects only newly created releases, never existing snapshots. Maximum 100 items.
readiness.noSnapshot: This release has an empty checklist snapshot. Later template edits will not add items here.
readiness.manualNotice: Manual QA only. Approval records a readiness decision; it does not deploy or publish this release.
readiness.gateNotice: Mandatory checklist items must be complete. Approval also requires passed QA. Only an owner can override unmet requirements with a recorded reason. Moving out of draft locks release content.
readiness.reopenNotice: Reopening revokes approval and resets the QA result. Checklist completion is retained. The reason is recorded in audit history.
readiness.overrideReason: Owner override reason (only needed for unmet requirements)

changes.title: Included changes
changes.deleteDescription: Remove this change from the draft? The deletion remains in the internal audit history.

portal.description: One public link for all included applications in this workspace. Visitors can filter by application.
portal.revokeDescription: The current link will stop working. Enabling the catalog again creates a new link.
portal.title: Release notes
